title: Eight products land in twelve cities
description: bubble = paying accounts · each row bows like a horizon

props.name: data
props.description: Paying-account counts by product and city. Bubbles follow bowed product rows across city columns; each product/city pair is one observation. Zero is measured absence, while omitted pairs are missing.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total component height in pixels; otherwise retains the original plot aspect ratio.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills the containing element.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.
